t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp: Requiem for Old Man Clanton
d: Wyatt tries to put a stop to ongoing border skirmishes between the Clanton gang and Mexican bandits.
Peter arrives in Sacramento to revive his family's fortune but learns Phineas Colby has monopolized the town.
Zack and Zeke, slaves from Louisville, seek to buy their freedom by digging for gold.
John is given the task of turning a small group of Apache men into a force that can aid the U.S. Calvary.
A singer wants to give up the fame and return home.
Farmer Carlo Farelli wants to marry beautiful saloon girl Della but must first deal with a town gangster.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp: The Hole Up
d: Wells Fargo asks Earp to go undercover into the badlands to capture Blackie Saunders wanted for a robbery and murder.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp: Loyalty
d: Doc Holliday hits a long winning streak at the card tables and winds up with stock in a mine and railroad, both of which soon have a tremendous jump in value.
Sam Kee, ostracized because he's Chinese, finds refuge at a fort after saving a soldier's life.
A notorious Apache is in the area and a local captain's son is missing.
A boy runs away from home and into the arms of an outlaw after a falling out with his father.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
d: Earp recalls in court the details of the day when the Clanton gang rode into Tombstone to shoot it out with the Earps.
Cowpoke Curt Morrison and pal Josh locate a spring on Native land soon to be opened to homesteaders.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp: Wyatt Meets Doc Holliday
d: Earp is looking for information on Mike Roarke at Shanssey's Camp where he finds Doc Holliday may be able to help. Doc refuses as he has his own agenda with Roarke.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp: Warpath
d: An Army officer is captured by Pawnee Indians who have left the reservation and bought faulty guns.
Colonel Lounsberry is selected by General Custer to be the only newspaperman to travel with the troops.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp: Old Jake
d: Earp spots old buffalo hunter Jake Caster in a saloon. Jake now lives with his wife's tribe, the Cheyenne, but Earp wonders if Jake has changed his ways.
Doc Holliday, looking for cash to finance his gambling, tries to con a banker out of $20,000.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp: Fortitude
d: Earp is invited to speak at the Cattlemen's Convention at the Dodge City Opera House. But a source tells Kate Holliday that it is a setup by Texas cattlemen to kill Earp.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp: Tombstone
d: Earp decides to ride into Tombstone alone and unarmed to see for himself how bad it is. He finds himself caught in the midst of an ongoing dispute between the miners and Clantons.
As the Donner Party attempts to cross the Sierra Nevada Mountains, and the Reed family is banished.
Warren takes an unreasonable dislike to his stepmother after returning to his father's ranch.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp: Casey and the Clowns
d: Earp prepares for trouble when a group known as the Harlequins is expected to return to town. Although they disguise themselves as clowns, they have sinister intentions.
A widow's ranch is requisitioned by the Union Army, making her the target of Confederate cavalrymen.
In Apache country, a missionary engages in a philosophic battle with an escaped murderer.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp: The Vultures
d: Two bounty hunters arrive in the Dodge City area looking for a wanted man. They shoot him for a $1000 reward. Earp agrees to get their money but wants them out of town.

st: The Private Mint of Clark, Gruber and Co.
d: Plagued by gold thefts, Denver bankers set up their own mint in the bank basement.

st: A Gun Is Not a Gentleman
d: Unable to come to terms, a U.S. senator and a Supreme Court justice agree to a duel.
Wells Fargo stage driver Charlie Parkhurst wins fame for his daring endeavors.
Jeb Slade talks his brother Billy into helping him rob Aaron Winters, who is wealthy from his borax findings.
Buff McCloud runs a Nevada town with an iron fist — until a stranger arrives.

t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp: Wyatt's Decision
d: Earp decides to leave Tombstone but learns the Clantons are gunning for him. Nellie Cashman and Dick Gird want Earp to stay to bring law and order to Tombstone.
